arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ خَلَقْتَنِي سَوِيّاً، وَرَبَّيْتَنِي صَغِيراً، وَرَزَقْتَنِي مَكْفِيّاً.
transliteration: allāhumma innaka khalaqtanī sawiyyan wa rabbaytanī ṣaghīran, wa razaqtanī makfiyyan
english_text: O God, Thou created me without fault, nurtured me when small, and provided me with sufficiency.

arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّي وَجَدْتُ فِيمَا أَنْزَلْتَ مِنْ كِتَابِكَ، وَبَشَّرْتَ بِهِ عِبَادِكَ، أَنْ قُلْتَ: (يا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ لاَ تَقْنَطُوا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللهِ إنَّ اللهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعاً)
transliteration: allāhumma innī wajadtu fīmā anzalta min kitābika wa bashsharta bihi ʿibādika 'an qult: (ya 'ibadiyya alladhina asrafu 'ala anfusihim...) la taqnato min rahmati allah, inna allah yaghfiru al dhunub jamī'an
english_text: O God, I found in the Book which Thou sent down and through which Thou gave good news to Thy servants, that Thou said, O My servants who hare been prodigal against yourselves, do not despair of God's mercy, surely God forgives all sins,

arabic_text: وَقَدْ تَقَدَّمَ مِنِّي مَا قَدْ عَلِمْتَ، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي،
transliteration: wa qad taqaddama minnī mā qad ʿalimta wa mā anta aʿlamu bihī minnī
english_text: but there has gone ahead from me what Thou knowest (and of which Thou knowest more than I)!

arabic_text: فَيَا سَوْأَتا مِمَّا أَحْصَاهُ عَلَيَّ كِتَابُكَ،
transliteration: fayā saw'atā mimmā aḥṣāhu ʿalayya kitābuka
english_text: O the shame of what Thy Book has counted against me!

arabic_text: فَلَوْلاَ الْمَوَاقِفُ الَّتِي أُؤَمِّلُ مِنْ عَفْوِكَ الَّذِي شَمِلَ كُلَّ شَيْء لاَلْقَيْتُ بِيَدِي،
transliteration: falawlā al-mawāqifu allatī 'u'milu min 'afwik al-ladhī shamila kulla shay'in lālqaytu biyadī
english_text: Were it not for the places where I expectantly hope for Thy pardon, which enfolds all things, I would have thrown myself down [in despair]!

arabic_text: وَلَوْ أَنَّ أَحَداً اسْتَطاعَ الْهَرَبَ مِنْ رَبِّهِ لَكُنْتُ أَنَا أَحَقُّ بِالهَرَبِ،
transliteration: wa law anna ahadan istata'a al-haraba min rabbihi lakuntu ana ahaqqu bil-harabi
english_text: Were anyone able to flee from his Lord, I would be the most obligated to flee from Thee!

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ لاَ تَخْفَى عَلَيْكَ خَافِيَةٌ فِي الاَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السَّمَآءِ إلاَّ أَتَيْتَ بِهَا،
transliteration: wa-anta laa takhfā ʿalayka khāfiyatun fil-ardh wa lā fī as-samāʾi illā atayta bihā
english_text: But not a secret in earth and heaven is concealed from Thee, except that Thou bringest it.

arabic_text: وَكَفى بِكَ جَازِياً، وَكَفى بِكَ حَسِيباً.
transliteration: wakafā bika jāzīan, wakafā bika ḥasīban
english_text: Thou sufficest as a recompenser! Thou sufficest as a reckoner!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ طَالِبِي إنْ أَنَا هَرَبْتُ، وَمُدْرِكِي إنْ أَنَا فَرَرْتُ،
transliteration: allāhumma innaka ṭālibī in anā harabtu wa mudrikī in anā farartu
english_text: O God, surely Thou wouldst seek me if I flee and catch me if I run.

arabic_text: فَهَا أَنَا ذَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ خَاضِعٌ ذَلِيلٌ رَاغِمٌ،
transliteration: fahā ana dhā bayna yadayka khāḍiʿun dhaleelun rāghimun
english_text: So here I am before Thee, abject, lowly, abased.

arabic_text: إنْ تُعَذِّبْنِي فَإنّي لِذلِكَ أَهْلٌ، وَهُوَ يَارَبِّ مِنْكَ عَدْلٌ،
transliteration: in tuʿaḏḏibnī faʾinnī liḏalika ahlu wa huwa yā rabbi minka ʿadlun
english_text: If Thou chastisest me, I am worthy of that, and it would be, my Lord, an act of justice from Thee.

arabic_text: وَإنْ تَعْفُ عَنِّي فَقَدِيماً شَمَلَنِي عَفْوُكَ، سْتَنِي عَافِيَتَكَ.
transliteration: wa in taʿfu ʿannī faqadīman shamalanī ʿafwuka sṭanī ʿāfiyatka
english_text: But if Thou pardonest me, anciently has Thy pardon enfolded me and Thy well-being garmented me!

arabic_text: فَأَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ بِالْمَخْزونِ مِنْ أَسْمائِكَ، وَبِمَا وَارتْهُ الْحُجُبُ مِنْ بَهَائِكَ،
transliteration: fa-as'aluka allahumma bilmakhzuni min asma'ika wa bimā wārathu al-ḥujubu min bahā'ika
english_text: So I ask Thee, O God, by Thy names stored in Thy treasury and Thy splendour masked by the veils!

arabic_text: إلاَّ رَحِمْتَ هذِهِ النَّفْسَ الْجَزُوعَةَ، وَهَذِهِ الرِّمَّةَ الْهَلُوعَةَ، الَّتِي لاَ تَسْتَطِيعُ حَرَّ شَمْسِكَ، فَكَيْفَ تَسْتَطِيعُ حَرَّ نارِكَ؟
transliteration: illā raḥimta hādhīhi al-nafs al-jazūʿah wa-ha-dhi-hi al-ri-ma-ta al-ha-luʿa-ta al-latī lā tastaṭīʿu ḥarra shamsika fakayfa tastaṭīʿu ḥarra nārika?
english_text: If Thou hast no mercy upon this anxious soul and these uneasy, decaying bones - he cannot endure the heat of Thy sun, so how can he endure the heat of Thy Fire?

arabic_text: وَالَّتِي لاَ تَسْتَطِيعُ صَوْتَ رَعْدِكَ، فَكَيْفَ تَسْتَطِيعُ صَوْتَ غَضَبِكَ؟
transliteration: wal-latī lā tastaṭīʿu ṣawta raʿdika fakayfa tastateeʿu sawta ghadabika?
english_text: He cannot endure the sound of Thy thunder, so how can he endure the sound of Thy wrath?

arabic_text: فَارْحَمْنِي اللَّهُمَّ فَإنِّي امْرُؤٌ حَقِيرٌ، وَخَطَرِي يَسِيرٌ،
transliteration: fārhamnī allāhumma fa-innī amru'un haqīrun, wa-khaṭarī yasīrun
english_text: So have mercy upon me, O God, for I am a vile man and my worth is little.

arabic_text: وَلَيْسَ عَذَابِي مِمَّا يَزِيدُ فِي مُلْكِكَ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّة،
transliteration: wa laysa ʿadhabī mimmā yazīdu fī mulkika mithqāla dharratin
english_text: Chastising me will not add the weight of a dust mote to Thy kingdom.

arabic_text: وَلَوْ أَنَّ عَذَابِي مِمَّا يَزِيدُ فِي مُلْكِكَ لَسَأَلْتُكَ الصَّبْرَ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ ذلِكَ لَكَ،
transliteration: walaw anna `adhabī mimmā yazeedu fī mulkika las'altuka al-ṣabara ʿalayhi wa-ʾaḥbabtu ʾan yakuuna ḏạlika lak
english_text: Were chastising me something that would add to Thy kingdom, I would ask Thee for patience to bear it and would love for it to belong to Thee;

arabic_text: وَلكِنْ سُلْطَانُكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَعْظَمُ، وَمُلْكُكَ أَدْوَمُ مِنْ أَنْ تَزِيـدَ فِيْهِ طَاعَةُ الْمُطِيعِينَ، أَوْ تُنْقِصَ مِنْهُ مَعْصِيَةُ الْمُذْنِبِينَ.
transliteration: walakin sultaanuka allahumma a'dhamu wa mulkuka adwamu min an tazeeda feehi taa'atul muti'een aw tunqiṣa minhu maʿṣiyatu almudhnibin
english_text: but Thy authority, my God, is mightier, and Thy kingdom more lasting, than that the obedience of the obeyers should increase it or the disobedience of the sinners diminish it!

arabic_text: فَارْحَمْنِي يا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ،
transliteration: farḥamnī yā arḥama al-rāḥimīn
english_text: So have mercy upon me, O Most Merciful of the merciful!

arabic_text: وَتَجاوَزْ عَنِّي يا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإكْرَامِ،
transliteration: wa tajāwaz ʿannī yā dhā l-jalāli wal-ikrām
english_text: Show me forbearance, O Possessor of majesty and munificence!

arabic_text: وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ.
transliteration: wa tub ʿalayya innaka anta at-tawwabu ar-rahim
english_text: And turn toward me, Surely Thou art Ever-turning, All-compassionate!
